title: German Irish Sausage Fry
description: A hearty German-inspired dish featuring juicy Irish sausage, sautéed with green onions and olives. Serve with a side of crispy bread.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the Irish sausage and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the chopped green onions and cook until they start to soften, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the sliced olives and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Serve hot with crispy bread on the side.
